definitions.ask: Should the rotated tui_stalls.jsonl keep at least 48 hours of rows instead of the sibling logs' 2 MiB cap?
definitions.why: tui_stalls.jsonl is the acceptance metric, and 2 MiB holds only ~4 h of athena rows

choices.label: Size-rotate at a cap that holds 48 h of athena rows, and slim per-pause rows
Rotate at the siblings' 2 MiB cap; soaks over a few hours must copy the log out
